description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of the QuestionnaireApiController class, which handles API requests related to questionnaire document uploads within the Goteo project. It defines an AJAX method for uploading files, processes uploaded images, and returns JSON responses with upload status.

classes.name: QuestionnaireApiController
classes.description: Controller for handling questionnaire-related API endpoints, specifically file uploads

methods.name: questionnaireUploadDocumentsAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX file upload for questionnaire documents, processes each file, saves images, and returns a JSON response
